scripts.build:cf: vite build --config vite.config.cloudflare.ts && vite build --config vite.config.state.ts
scripts.deploy:staging: vite build --config vite.config.cloudflare.ts && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.staging.toml
scripts.deploy:staging:dry: vite build --config vite.config.cloudflare.ts && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.staging.toml --dry-run --outdir=dist/worker
scripts.deploy:production: vite build --config vite.config.cloudflare.ts && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.production.toml
scripts.deploy:production:dry: vite build --config vite.config.cloudflare.ts && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.production.toml --dry-run --outdir=dist/worker
scripts.db:apply:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply tanstack-start-template-d1-staging --remote --config wrangler.staging.toml
scripts.db:apply:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply tanstack-start-template-d1-production --remote --config wrangler.production.toml
